name: Sparse Voxel Octree Memory Management and Texture Upload
definition: A memory management system for sparse voxel octrees that uses a flat integer array `_data` to store branch pointers, leaf attributes, and free memory blocks. It supports incremental updates to a 3D texture by tracking changes per 256x256 slice.
summary: This method manages Sparse Voxel Octree memory in a flat array and optimizes GPU uploads by transferring only modified 256x256 slices, differing from other methods by focusing on memory compaction and incremental synchronization.
